annotations.title: Find marketplace health plans in a state

description: Finds marketplace health plans in a state for a plan year, optionally narrowed by plan name, insurer or plan ID. Returns up to 20 plans ordered by deductible, low to high, then by name, as the site lists them, with each plan's ID, metal level, insurer, deductible and out-of-pocket maximum as the CMS file states them, and its drug list size. Premiums are not in the public file. The amounts are not a quote for you.

query.description: Words from the plan name or the insurer name, or a plan ID.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.

year.description: The plan year, such as 2027. The default is the latest year OpenHealth reads.

name: find_health_plans
title: Find marketplace health plans in a state
